thread:
zoe: quick sync  EU inference flakiness earlier. Need one canonical status blurb + staged comms plan + where inbound demos/lead asks land. Drafting initial copy + timing.

zoe: DRAFT STATUS (short):

We experienced intermittent inference failures in the EU region between 01:52 and 02:18 UTC. A networking configuration change caused degraded routing to a portion of GPU pools; the change was reverted and normal service resumed at 02:18 UTC. Traffic and automated health checks are currently normal. No customer data was exposed as a result of this incident.

We will publish a post-incident report within 48 hours with timeline and mitigations.

ben: copy looks good. Two notes: 1) swap "networking configuration change" -> "routing configuration change" for clarity; 2) add a one-line reassurance for benchmarking customers about result consistency.

lila: I like the reassurance idea. Suggest: "Model outputs and embeddings were not materially affected; if you see anomalies, contact support." Keep it short.

tim: On cadence: propose staged approach: 1) status page short RESOLVED now; 2) targeted Detailed email to Dedicated & Private in 45m (SEs CC'd) with call list for accounts >5% EU; 3) hosted banner + short hosted email in 6 hours linking to status; 4) public blog/postmortem with timeline + appendix in 48h.

ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-198 recorded: EU inference degradation  resolved at 1772505480 (02:18 UTC). Postmortem assigned to @eng-runtime.

zoe: support, can you estimate ticket volume and recommend subject tag?

sales-ops: Sales-ops: We'll quarantine inbound demo/trial requests for 24 hours so we can prioritize known accounts and avoid duplicate outreach. Tag all incident emails with "incident-eu-quarantine-2026". Any renewal-related messages flagged HIGH and routed to account teams.

ben: Support estimate: expect 8-18 tickets. Please add header: incident-eu-2026 to internal routing.

lila: For Dedicated email subject suggestion: "Service update  EU region (resolved 02:18 UTC)  impact & next steps". For hosted: "Notice: brief EU inference disruption ".

tim: SEs: Ops will produce a call list in 30m. Please prioritize accounts with SLAs and >5% EU traffic. Do not cold-call trials.

sales-ops: Confirmed: inbound demo/trial emails get quarantine routing to sales-ops-incident for 24h. Known accounts and renewal signals go straight to account execs. We'll post a daily digest to #sales-ops-incident.

zoe: Updated final status copy (for status page + header):

We experienced intermittent inference failures in the EU region between 01:52 and 02:18 UTC. A routing configuration change caused degraded routing to a subset of GPU pools; the change was reverted and services returned to normal at 02:18 UTC. Traffic and automated health checks are normal. No customer data was exposed as a result of this incident. Model outputs and embeddings were not materially affected; if you observe an issue, contact support@redwood.ai.

A post-incident report with timeline and mitigations will be published within 48 hours. If you need immediate assistance, reach out to support@redwood.ai or your assigned SE.

ben: LGTM. Small nit: change "were not materially affected" -> "were not materially affected for production workloads".

lila: Keep as-is for tone.

zoe: OK sending targeted email to Dedicated + Private in 45m with subject above. SE call list to follow from ops. Sales-ops will hold inbound demos for 24h and triage renewals immediately.

sales-ops: We'll monitor inbound leads and post tally in #sales-ops-incident. Flagging any renewal risks immediately.
